summary: Nova Minerals Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting results of scheme meetings for a corporate redomiciliation to a US holding company, Nova Minerals Corp. Shareholders (98.88% in favor) and warrant holders (99.89% in favor) approved the schemes of arrangement. The transaction involves no change in control or price per share; it is a structural move to shift the parent entity to the US. Final court approval is scheduled for June 2, 2026, with implementation expected June 16, 2026. Watch for court approval and any regulatory conditions; no traditional deal arbitrage applies as no acquisition premium or cash consideration is involved.
